1061: within them His firm command prevails.
ਹੁਕਮੇ ਸਾਜੇ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਢਾਹੇ; ਹੁਕਮੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੫॥
By His command He creates, by His command He destroys; by His command He unites in union. ॥5॥
One who understands the command praises the command,
ਜੇਹੀ ਮਤਿ ਦੇਹਿ. ਸੋ ਹੋਵੈ; ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੁਝਾਇਦਾ ॥੬॥
As is the intellect You give, so one becomes; You Yourself give understanding through the Word. ॥6॥
Night and day one's lifespan is wasting away;
night and day both stand witness to it.
ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਅੰਧੁ. ਨ ਚੇਤੈ ਮੂੜਾ; ਸਿਰ ਊਪਰਿ, ਕਾਲੁ ਰੂਆਇਦਾ ॥੭॥
The blind, foolish self-willed does not remember; death roars over his head. ॥7॥
ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ; ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
Mind and body are cooled by clinging to the Guru's feet;
doubt within is gone and fear has fled.
ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਸਚੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ; ਸਚੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਬੋਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੮॥
Those who sing the praises of the True One are ever in bliss; the True One inspires them to speak the bani. ॥8॥
One who has known You, the Architect of destiny,
by perfect fortune recognised You through the Guru's Word.
ਜਤਿ ਪਤਿ ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਈ; ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੯॥
The True One alone becomes his caste and honour; killing his ego, He unites him. ॥9॥
The mind is hard, attached to the love of duality;
the unfortunate one wanders, led astray by doubt.
ਕਰਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਤਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ; ਸਹਜੇ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੦॥
When grace comes, he serves the True Guru and finds peace in poise. ॥10॥
He Himself created the 8.4 million species;
in human birth the Guru implants devotion.
ਬਿਨੁ ਭਗਤੀ. ਬਿਸਟਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਾਸਾ; ਬਿਸਟਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੧॥
Without devotion one dwells in filth and is cast back into filth again. ॥11॥
When grace comes, the Guru implants devotion;
without grace, how can He be found?
ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ਕਰਤਾ; ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਚਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੨॥
The Creator Himself acts and causes to act; as it pleases Him, so He makes all walk. ॥12॥
Through the Simritis and Shastras one does not know His limit;
the blind fool does not recognise the essence.
ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ਕਰਤਾ; ਆਪੇ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੩॥
The Creator Himself acts and causes to act; He Himself leads astray in doubt. ॥13॥
He Himself causes everything to be done;
He Himself yokes each and every one to their tasks.
ਆਪੇ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪੇ ਵੇਖੈ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੪॥
He Himself establishes, disestablishes and watches; through the Guru He Himself gives understanding. ॥14॥
True is the Master, deep and profound;
praising Him ever, the mind is steadied.
ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ. ਕੀਮਤਿ, ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੫॥
Inaccessible, Imperceptible, His worth cannot be found; through the Guru He enshrines Himself in the mind. ॥15॥
He Himself is detached; the rest of the world is entangled in affairs.
By the Guru's grace some rare one understands.
ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ; ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੬॥੩॥੧੭॥
Nanak, the Name dwells within the heart; through the Guru's teaching He unites in union. ॥16॥3॥17॥
For thirty-six ages You kept utter darkness;
You Yourself know it, O Creator.
ਹੋਰ ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਕਹੈ ਕਿ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੈ; ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧॥
What else can anyone say or describe? You Yourself know its worth. ॥1॥
The One Creator (Onkar) created the whole universe;
the whole play and spectacle is Your glory.
ਆਪੇ ਵੇਕ ਕਰੇ ਸਭਿ ਸਾਚਾ; ਆਪੇ ਭੰਨਿ ਘੜਾਇਦਾ ॥੨॥
The True One Himself makes all distinct; He Himself breaks and shapes. ॥2॥
The Juggler has staged a show;
through the Perfect Guru it comes into view.
ਸਦਾ ਅਲਿਪਤੁ ਰਹੈ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ; ਸਾਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੩॥
Through the Guru's Word one remains ever detached, with the mind fixed on the True One. ॥3॥
The bodies are instruments playing their melody;
ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਪਉਣੁ ਵਹੈ ਇਕ ਰੰਗੀ; ਮਿਲਿ ਪਵਣੈ ਸਭ ਵਜਾਇਦਾ ॥੪॥
In each and every heart the breath of the One flows; joining with the breath, He plays them all. ॥4॥
1062: Whatever the Creator does certainly happens;
through the Guru's Word one loses ego.
ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਕਿਸੈ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ; ਨਾਮੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਦਾ ॥੫॥
By the Guru's grace He grants glory to some, who meditate on the Name alone. ॥5॥
ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਜੇਵਡੁ; ਹੋਰੁ ਲਾਹਾ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
There is no profit as great as serving the Guru;
the Name dwells in the mind, and one praises the Name alone.
ਨਾਮੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ; ਨਾਮੋ ਲਾਹਾ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੬॥
The Name alone is ever the Giver of peace; through the Name one earns profit. ॥6॥
Without the Name the whole world is in pain;
people perform many rituals, and their vices increase.
ਨਾਮੁ. ਨ ਸੇਵਹਿ, ਕਿਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ; ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ. ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੭॥
If they do not serve the Name, how can they find peace? Without the Name one suffers pain. ॥7॥
He Himself acts and Himself causes to act;
by the Guru's grace He gives understanding to some.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਸੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਤੋੜਹਿ; ਮੁਕਤੀ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੮॥
Those who become Guru-facing break their bonds; He places them in the home of liberation. ॥8॥
One who keeps calculating burns in the world;
his anxiety and vices never end.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਗਣਤ ਚੁਕਾਏ; ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੯॥
One who becomes Guru-facing ends calculation and merges in the Truest of the true. ॥9॥
ਜੇ ਸਚੁ ਦੇਇ; ਤ ਪਾਏ ਕੋਈ ॥
If the True One gives, then one obtains it;
by the Guru's grace He becomes manifest.
ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੇ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ; ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੦॥
Dyed in His love, he praises the True Name; by the Guru's grace he finds peace. ॥10॥
The beloved Name is chanting, austerity and self-discipline;
the Destroyer of sins destroys one's sins.
ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ. ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਹੋਆ; ਸਹਜੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੧॥
Through the Lord's Name body and mind are cooled; one merges in poise upon poise. ॥11॥
ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲੋਭੁ; ਮਨਿ ਮੈਲੈ. ਮਲੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
Greed within: with a filthy mind one gathers more filth;
doing filthy deeds, one suffers pain.
ਕੂੜੋ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਰੇ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ; ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਲਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੨॥
One deals in falsehood upon falsehood, and speaking falsehood suffers pain. ॥12॥
Some rare one enshrines the pure bani in the mind;
by the Guru's grace anxiety departs.
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਚਲੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ; ਨਾਮੁ ਚੇਤਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੩॥
Walking in the Guru's will day and night, remembering the Name, one finds peace. ॥13॥
That True One Himself is the Creator;
He Himself creates and Himself destroys.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ. ਸੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਲਾਹੇ; ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੪॥
One who becomes Guru-facing ever praises Him, and meeting the True One finds peace. ॥14॥
ਅਨੇਕ ਜਤਨ ਕਰੇ; ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਵਸਿ. ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
One may make countless efforts, yet the senses are not controlled;
everyone burns in lust and anger.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ. ਮਨੁ ਵਸਿ ਆਵੈ; ਮਨ ਮਾਰੇ ਮਨਹਿ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੫॥
Serving the True Guru, the mind comes under control; subduing the mind, one merges in the mind within. ॥15॥
ਸਭਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਜੰਤ; ਤੇਰੇ ਸਭਿ ਜੀਆ ॥
all creatures are Yours, all beings are Yours.
ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ਸਦਾ ਤੂ; ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੬॥੪॥੧੮॥
Nanak, ever remember the Name; through the Guru's teaching He is enshrined in the mind. ॥16॥4॥18॥
The dear Lord is the Giver, inaccessible and unfathomable;
He has not a particle of greed; He is carefree.
ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਅਪੜਿ. ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਈ; ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੧॥
No one can reach Him; He Himself unites in union. ॥1॥
ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੈ; ਸੁ ਨਿਹਚਉ ਹੋਈ ॥
Whatever He does certainly comes to pass;
ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦਾਤਾ; ਅਵਰੁ. ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
without Him there is no other giver.
ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਾਮ ਦਾਨੁ ਕਰੇ. ਸੋ ਪਾਏ; ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਮੇਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੨॥
One to whom He grants the gift of the Name obtains it; He unites him through the Guru's Word. ॥2॥
The fourteen worlds are Your markets;
the True Guru has shown them to be within, alongside.
ਨਾਵੈ ਕਾ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ਹੋਵੈ; ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਕੋ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੩॥
One becomes a trader in the Name; some rare one obtains it through the Guru's Word. ॥3॥
1063: Serving the True Guru comes the bliss of poise;
the Lord of the universe comes to dwell in the heart.
ਸਹਜੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ; ਆਪੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਾਇਦਾ ॥੪॥
In poise one worships Him day and night; He Himself inspires devotion. ॥4॥
ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਵਿਛੁੜੇ; ਤਿਨੀ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Those separated from the True Guru suffer pain;
night and day they are struck down by every pain.
ਮਥੇ ਕਾਲੇ. ਮਹਲੁ, ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ; ਦੁਖ ਹੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੫॥
With blackened faces, they do not reach His mansion; they suffer pain upon pain. ॥5॥
Those who serve the True Guru are very fortunate;
in poise they are lovingly attuned to the True One.
ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਸਦ ਹੀ; ਸਚੈ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੬॥
They ever practise the Truest of the true; He unites them with the True One. ॥6॥
ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਸਚਾ ਦੇਇ ਸੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
One to whom the True One gives obtains it;
with Truth within, doubt is dispelled.
ਸਚੁ ਸਚੈ ਕਾ ਆਪੇ ਦਾਤਾ; ਜਿਸੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੭॥
The True One Himself is the Giver of Truth; whoever He gives to obtains Truth. ॥7॥
He Himself is the Creator of all;
ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ; ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
one whom He Himself enlightens understands.
ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸੇ. ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ; ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੮॥
He Himself forgives and grants glory; He Himself unites in union. ॥8॥
Acting in ego, one wastes his life;
even hereafter attachment to Maya does not leave him.
ਅਗੈ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਲੇਖਾ ਲੇਵੈ; ਜਿਉ ਤਿਲ ਘਾਣੀ ਪੀੜਾਇਦਾ ॥੯॥
Hereafter Death calls him to account, and he is crushed like sesame in the oil press. ॥9॥
By perfect destiny one serves the Guru;
when He casts His glance, then some rare one serves.
ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਨੇੜਿ. ਨ ਆਵੈ; ਮਹਲਿ ਸਚੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੦॥
Death does not come near him; in the True One's mansion he finds peace. ॥10॥
ਤਿਨ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਏ ॥
They alone find peace who are pleasing to You;
by perfect destiny You attach them to the Guru's service.
ਤੇਰੈ ਹਥਿ ਹੈ ਸਭ ਵਡਿਆਈ; ਜਿਸੁ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਸੋ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੧॥
All glory is in Your hands; whoever You give it to obtains it. ॥11॥
One obtains light within from the Guru,
and enshrines the treasure of the Name in the mind.
ਗਿਆਨ ਰਤਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਘਟਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ; ਅਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਧੇਰੁ ਗਵਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੨॥
The jewel of wisdom is ever a light in the heart, dispelling the darkness of ignorance. ॥12॥
The blind ignorant are attached to duality;
the unfortunate drown and die without water.
ਚਲਦਿਆ ਘਰੁ ਦਰੁ ਨਦਰਿ. ਨ ਆਵੈ; ਜਮ ਦਰਿ ਬਾਧਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੩॥
Departing, they see neither home nor door; bound at Death's door, they suffer pain. ॥13॥
ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ; ਮੁਕਤਿ. ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
Without serving the True Guru there is no liberation;
ask any of the learned or contemplatives.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ; ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੪॥
One who serves the True Guru obtains glory and is honoured at the true door. ॥14॥
ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨੋ ਸੇਵੇ; ਤਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
One who serves the True Guru, He Himself unites;
cutting away possessiveness, he is lovingly attuned to the True One.
ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਵਣਜਹਿ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ; ਨਾਮੋ ਲਾਹਾ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੫॥
The traders ever deal in Truth and earn the profit of the Name. ॥15॥
The Creator Himself acts and causes to act;
that person alone is liberated who dies through the Word.
ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ; ਨਾਮੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਦਾ ॥੧੬॥੫॥੧੯॥
Nanak, the Name dwells within his mind; he meditates on the Name alone. ॥16॥5॥19॥
ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਕਰਣਾ; ਸੋ ਕਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Whatever You wish to do, You do;
some rare one walks in Your will.
ਭਾਣਾ ਮੰਨੇ. ਸੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ; ਭਾਣੇ ਵਿਚਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧॥
One who accepts Your will finds peace; in Your will he finds peace. ॥1॥
To the Guru-facing, Your will is pleasing;
in poise he finds peace and practises Truth.
ਭਾਣੇ ਨੋ ਲੋਚੈ ਬਹੁਤੇਰੀ; ਆਪਣਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਆਪਿ ਮਨਾਇਦਾ ॥੨॥
Very many long to accept His will; He Himself makes one accept His will. ॥2॥
ਤੇਰਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਮੰਨੇ; ਸੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਏ ॥
One who accepts Your will comes and meets You;
1064: ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਭਾਵੈ; ਸੋ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
one to whom Your will is pleasing merges in You.
ਭਾਣੇ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ; ਭਾਣਾ ਕਿਸਹਿ ਕਰਾਇਦਾ ॥੩॥
In His will is great glory; He makes some rare one walk in His will. ॥3॥
ਜਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ; ਤਾ ਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
When it pleases Him, He unites one with the Guru;
the Guru-facing obtains the treasure of the Name.
ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪਣੈ ਭਾਣੈ. ਸਭ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਈ; ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਭਾਣਾ ਦੇਹਿ. ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਇਦਾ ॥੪॥
By Your will You created the whole universe; one to whom You give Your will finds it pleasing. ॥4॥
ਭਾਣਾ ਨ ਮੰਨੇ; ਬਹੁਤੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ॥
he does not accept His will and suffers great pain.
ਭਰਮੇ ਭੂਲਾ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਏ; ਘਰੁ ਮਹਲੁ. ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੫॥
Led astray by doubt, he comes and goes and never finds His home and mansion. ॥5॥
He unites one with the True Guru and grants glory;
service of the True Guru was ordained from the start.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਏ; ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੬॥
Serving the True Guru one obtains the Name; through the Name alone one finds peace. ॥6॥
From the Name everything wells up; through the Name everything (evil) wastes away;
ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ; ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਭੀਜੈ ॥
by the Guru's grace mind and body are drenched.
ਰਸਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ਰਸਿ ਭੀਜੈ; ਰਸ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੭॥
The tongue meditates on the Name and is drenched with its essence; from that essence one obtains more essence. ॥7॥
Some rare one finds the mansion within the mansion (of the body),
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ; ਸਚਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
fixing the mind on the True One through the Guru's Word.
ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਸਚੁ ਦੇਇ. ਸੋਈ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਏ; ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੮॥
One to whom the True One gives Truth obtains it, and is united in the Truest of the true. ॥8॥
ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ; ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Forgetting the Name, mind and body suffer pain;
through attachment to Maya one has earned only disease.
ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ. ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹੈ ਕੁਸਟੀ; ਨਰਕੇ ਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੯॥
Without the Name mind and body are leprous; one dwells in hell. ॥9॥
Those imbued with the Name have pure bodies;
their soul-swans are pure, ever at peace in love.
ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੦॥
Praising the Name, one finds lasting peace and dwells in one's own home. ॥10॥
Everyone carries on trade and business;
without the Name the whole world is at a loss.
ਨਾਗੋ ਆਇਆ ਨਾਗੋ ਜਾਸੀ; ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ. ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੧॥
Naked one came and naked one will go; without the Name one suffers pain. ॥11॥
ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਇ; ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ॥
One to whom He gives the Name obtains it;
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ; ਹਰਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
through the Guru's Word he enshrines the Lord in the mind.
ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ. ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ; ਨਾਮੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਦਾ ॥੧੨॥
By the Guru's grace the Name dwells in his heart; he meditates on the Name alone. ॥12॥
ਨਾਵੈ ਨੋ ਲੋਚੈ; ਜੇਤੀ ਸਭ ਆਈ ॥
All who have come long for the Name;
ਨਾਉ ਤਿਨਾ ਮਿਲੈ; ਧੁਰਿ ਪੁਰਬਿ ਕਮਾਈ ॥
they alone obtain the Name who earned it by past deeds, by His ordinance.
ਜਿਨੀ ਨਾਉ ਪਾਇਆ. ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ; ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੩॥
Those who have obtained the Name are very fortunate; He unites them through the Guru's Word. ॥13॥
The fortress of the body is utterly infinite;
ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਬਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਰੇ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
ਸਚਾ ਨਿਆਉ ਸਚੋ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ; ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੪॥
True is His justice, true the trade; one obtains an unshakeable dwelling. ॥14॥
The inner chambers are beautiful, the place adorned;
some rare Guru-facing one has found this place.
ਇਤੁ ਸਾਥਿ ਨਿਬਹੈ ਸਾਲਾਹੇ ਸਚੇ; ਹਰਿ ਸਚਾ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੫॥
In this company (love) endures for one who praises the True One and enshrines the True Lord in the mind. ॥15॥
My Creator has made a wondrous design:
ਇਸੁ ਦੇਹੀ ਵਿਚਿ; ਸਭ ਵਥੁ ਪਾਈ ॥
He has placed all the treasure within this body.
ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਣਜਹਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੬॥੬॥੨੦॥
Nanak, those who trade in the Name are dyed in His love; some rare Guru-facing one obtains the Name. ॥16॥6॥20॥
The body becomes gold by reflecting on the Word;
ਤਿਥੈ ਹਰਿ ਵਸੈ; ਜਿਸ ਦਾ. ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰਾ ॥
there dwells the Lord, whose limit and far shores cannot be found.
ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਿਹੁ ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ; ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੧॥
Night and day serve the Lord through the true bani; the dear Lord unites through the Word. ॥1॥
1065: I am a sacrifice to those who remember the Lord;
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ; ਤਿਨ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਉ ॥
through the Guru's Word I join their company.
ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ. ਲਾਈ ਮੁਖਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ; ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਬਹਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਦਾ ॥੨॥
I apply their dust to my face and forehead — those who sit in the true congregation and sing His praises. ॥2॥
ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ; ਜੇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵਾ ॥
I sing the Lord's praises if I am pleasing to the Lord God;
with the Lord's Name within, one is beautified by the Word.
ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ. ਚਹੁ ਕੁੰਡੀ ਸੁਣੀਐ; ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੩॥
(Attuned to) the Guru's bani, one is heard of in all four directions, and merges in the True Name. ॥3॥
ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਸਾਚਾ; ਜਿ ਅੰਤਰੁ ਭਾਲੇ ॥
That person is true who searches within;
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ; ਹਰਿ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੇ ॥
through the Guru's Word the Lord beholds him with His glance.
ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਜਨੁ ਪਾਏ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ; ਨਦਰੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੪॥
Through the Guru's Word he applies the ointment of wisdom; the Gracious One unites him by His glance. ॥4॥
By great good fortune this body was obtained;
in human birth one fixes the mind on the Word.
ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ. ਸਭੁ ਅੰਧ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਿਸਹਿ ਬੁਝਾਇਦਾ ॥੫॥
Without the Word all is pitch darkness; through the Guru He gives understanding to some rare one. ॥5॥
Why have some even come? They waste their lives;
the self-willed are attached to the love of duality.
ਏਹ ਵੇਲਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਹਾਥਿ. ਨ ਆਵੈ; ਪਗਿ ਖਿਸਿਐ ਪਛੁਤਾਇਦਾ ॥੬॥
This chance will not come into one's hands again; when the foot slips, one repents. ॥6॥
Through the Guru's Word the body is pure;
ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਸੈ; ਸਚੁ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੀਰਾ ॥
within it dwells the True One, the Virtuous, the Profound.
ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਵੇਖੈ ਸਭ ਥਾਈ; ਸਚੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਦਾ ॥੭॥
He sees the Truest of the true in all places; hearing the True One, he enshrines Him in the mind. ॥7॥
Ego and calculation are removed through the Guru's Word;
ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ; ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਖਹੁ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
keep the dear Lord enshrined in the heart.
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਾਲਾਹੇ; ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੮॥
One who ever praises Him through the Guru's Word, meeting the True One, finds peace. ॥8॥
He alone remembers whom He Himself causes to remember;
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ; ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਏ ॥
through the Guru's Word He comes to dwell in the mind.
ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖੈ ਆਪੇ ਬੂਝੈ; ਆਪੈ ਆਪੁ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੯॥
He Himself sees, He Himself understands; He Himself merges in Himself. ॥9॥
ਜਿਨਿ ਮਨ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਥੁ ਪਾਈ; ਸੋਈ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
One who has found the treasure within the mind knows it;
through the Guru's Word he recognises his own self.
ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ; ਬਾਣੀ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੦॥
One who recognises his own self is pure; he proclaims the bani, the Word. ॥10॥
when through the Guru's Word one remembers the Virtuous, Profound One.
ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ; ਗੁਣ ਕਹਿ ਗੁਣੀ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੧॥
Dyed in His love, one sings His praises night and day; uttering His virtues, one merges in the Virtuous One. ॥11॥
ਏਹੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਸਭ. ਮੂਲੁ ਹੈ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
This body is all the root of Maya;
in the love of duality one is led astray by doubt.
ਹਰਿ. ਨ ਚੇਤੈ, ਸਦਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ; ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਚੇਤੇ. ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੨॥
One who does not remember the Lord ever suffers pain; without remembering the Lord one suffers pain. ॥12॥
One who serves the True Guru is approved;
ਕਾਇਆ ਹੰਸੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ; ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
body and soul are pure; he is known at the true door.
ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵੇ. ਹਰਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ; ਸੋਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੩॥
Serving the Lord, enshrining the Lord in the mind, he is beautified singing the Lord's praises. ॥13॥
ਬਿਨੁ ਭਾਗਾ; ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ. ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
Without good fortune the Guru cannot be served;
the self-willed go astray and die wailing.
ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਗੁਰ ਕੇਰੀ; ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੪॥
Those on whom the Guru's glance falls, the dear Lord Himself unites. ॥14॥
The fortress of the body has solid markets,
where the Guru-facing buys and safeguards the treasure.
ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ; ਊਤਮ ਪਦਵੀ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੫॥
Meditating on the Lord's Name day and night, he obtains the supreme status. ॥15॥
The True One Himself is the Giver of peace;
He is recognised through the Perfect Guru's Word.
ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹੇ ਸਾਚਾ; ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਕੋ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੬॥੭॥੨੧॥
Nanak, one praises the True Name; by perfect destiny some rare one obtains it. ॥16॥7॥21॥
1066: The Formless One created the world of form;
by His command He fashioned attachment to Maya.
ਆਪੇ ਖੇਲ ਕਰੇ ਸਭਿ ਕਰਤਾ; ਸੁਣਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਦਾ ॥੧॥
The Creator Himself stages all the plays; hearing of the True One, one enshrines Him in the mind. ॥1॥
ਮਾਇਆ ਮਾਈ; ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਪਰਸੂਤਿ ਜਮਾਇਆ ॥
From mother Maya He brought forth those of the three qualities;
He commanded Brahma (to compose) the four Vedas.
ਵਰ੍ਹੇ ਮਾਹ ਵਾਰ ਥਿਤੀ ਕਰਿ; ਇਸੁ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ, ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੨॥
Making years, months, weekdays and lunar days, He gives understanding in this world. ॥2॥
Through serving the Guru comes the excellent deed:
keep the Lord's Name enshrined in the heart.
ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਵਰਤੀ ਜਗ ਅੰਤਰਿ; ਇਸੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਤੇ. ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੩॥
The Guru's bani pervades the world; through this bani one obtains the Lord's Name. ॥3॥
One reads the Vedas and dwells on debates night and day;
he does not remember the Name and is bound by Death.
ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਸਦਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ; ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੪॥
In the love of duality he ever suffers pain, led astray by doubt of the three qualities. ॥4॥
The Guru-facing is lovingly attuned to the One alone;
the threefold desires are absorbed in the mind itself.
ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਮੁਕਤਾ; ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਦਾ ॥੫॥
Through the true Word he is ever liberated and casts off attachment to Maya. ॥5॥
ਜੋ ਧੁਰਿ ਰਾਤੇ; ਸੇ ਹੁਣਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
Those imbued from the start are imbued now;
by the Guru's grace they are intoxicated in poise.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਆਪੈ ਆਪੁ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੬॥
Serving the True Guru, one finds God forever; He unites one with Himself. ॥6॥
In attachment to Maya and doubt one does not find Him;
attached to the love of duality, one suffers pain.
ਸੂਹਾ ਰੰਗੁ. ਦਿਨ ਥੋੜੇ ਹੋਵੈ; ਇਸੁ ਜਾਦੇ ਬਿਲਮ. ਨ ਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੭॥
The crimson colour lasts only a few days; it takes no time to fade. ॥7॥
One who dyes this mind in His fear and love,
through this colour merges in the True One.
ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਕੋ ਇਹੁ ਰੰਗੁ ਪਾਏ; ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਰੰਗੁ ਚੜਾਇਦਾ ॥੮॥
By perfect destiny some rare one obtains this colour; through the Guru's teaching it is applied. ॥8॥
ਦਰਗਹ ਕਬ ਹੀ, ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
but never obtains honour in His court.
ਦੂਜੈ ਲਾਗੇ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ; ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ. ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੯॥
Attached to duality, he wastes his life; without understanding, he suffers pain. ॥9॥
My God has hidden Himself within;
by the Guru's grace the Lord is met when He unites.
ਸਚਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਚਾ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ; ਨਾਮੁ ਅਮੋਲਕੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੦॥
True is God, true the trade; one obtains the priceless Name. ॥10॥
ਇਸੁ ਕਾਇਆ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ; ਕਿਨੈ. ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
No one has found the worth of this body;
my Lord has made this design:
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ. ਸੁ ਕਾਇਆ ਸੋਧੈ; ਆਪਹਿ ਆਪੁ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੧॥
one who becomes Guru-facing purifies the body and merges self in Self. ॥11॥
ਕਾਇਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਤੋਟਾ; ਕਾਇਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਲਾਹਾ ॥
Within the body is loss, within the body is profit;
the Guru-facing searches for the Carefree Lord.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਣਜਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ; ਸਹਜੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੨॥
Trading through the Guru, one finds lasting peace and merges in poise upon poise. ॥12॥
True is His mansion, true His storehouses;
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੇ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ; ਮਨਿ ਮੇਲੇ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੩॥
The Guru-facing praises the Giver of peace; uniting Him with the mind, he knows His worth. ॥13॥
ਕਾਇਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਸਤੁ; ਕੀਮਤਿ. ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
The treasure is within the body, but its worth is not known;
through the Guru He Himself grants glory.
ਜਿਸ ਦਾ ਹਟੁ. ਸੋਈ ਵਥੁ ਜਾਣੈ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੇਇ. ਨ ਪਛੋਤਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੪॥
Whose shop it is, He alone knows the merchandise; He gives through the Guru and does not regret it. ॥14॥
ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ; ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
by the Guru's grace He is found.
ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਆਪੇ; ਸਬਦੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੫॥
He Himself unites in union; through the Word one merges in poise. ॥15॥
1067: The True One Himself unites through the Word;
through the Word He removes doubt from within.
ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ; ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੬॥੮॥੨੨॥
Nanak, through the Name comes glory; through the Name alone one finds peace. ॥16॥8॥22॥
You Yourself are merciful, inaccessible and unfathomable.
ਅਪੜਿ ਕੋਇ. ਨ ਸਕੈ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ; ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਮੇਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
No one can equal one whom You unite through the Guru's Word. ॥1॥
Those who are pleasing to You serve You;
through the Guru's Word they merge in the True One.
ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਰਵਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ; ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
Night and day they repeat Your praises; their tongues delight in the Lord's essence. ॥2॥
Those who die through the Word adorn their death;
ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ; ਹਿਰਦੈ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਹਿ ॥
they enshrine the Lord's virtues in their hearts.
ਜਨਮੁ ਸਫਲੁ. ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗੇ; ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
Attached to the Lord's feet, their lives are fruitful; they have cast off the love of duality. ॥3॥
The dear Lord Himself unites them in union,
who lose self through the Guru's Word.
ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤੀ ਰਾਤੇ; ਇਸੁ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
Night and day they are ever imbued with devotion to the Lord, earning profit in this world. ॥4॥
ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਕਹਾ; ਮੈ ਕਹਣੁ. ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
I would describe Your virtues, but they cannot be described;
ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾ; ਕੀਮਤਿ. ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
they have no end or limit; their worth cannot be found.
ਆਪੇ ਦਇਆ ਕਰੇ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ; ਗੁਣ ਮਹਿ ਗੁਣੀ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੫॥
When the Giver of peace Himself shows mercy, the virtuous one merges in the Virtuous. ॥5॥
ਇਸੁ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ; ਮੋਹੁ ਹੈ ਪਾਸਾਰਾ ॥
In this world attachment is spread out;
the ignorant self-willed is blind, in darkness.
ਧੰਧੈ ਧਾਵਤੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ; ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ. ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੬॥
Running after affairs he wastes his life; without the Name he suffers pain. ॥6॥
When grace comes, one finds the True Guru,
and burns away the filth of ego through the Word.
ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਚਾਨਣੁ; ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੭॥
The mind becomes pure; the jewel of wisdom gives light, dispelling the darkness of ignorance. ॥7॥
ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਮ ਅਨੇਕ; ਕੀਮਤਿ. ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
Your Names are countless; Your worth cannot be found;
may I enshrine the Lord's True Name in my heart.
ਕੀਮਤਿ. ਕਉਣੁ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੀ; ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੮॥
Who can appraise Your worth, O God? You Yourself are absorbed in poise. ॥8॥
The Name is priceless, inaccessible and infinite;
there has been no one able to weigh it.
ਆਪੇ ਤੋਲੇ ਤੋਲਿ ਤੋਲਾਏ; ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਮੇਲਿ ਤੋਲਾਇਆ ॥੯॥
He Himself weighs and teaches to weigh; through the Guru's Word He unites and teaches to weigh it. ॥9॥
Your servants serve You and offer prayer;
You Yourself unite them and seat them near You.
ਸਭਨਾ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ; ਪੂਰੈ ਕਰਮਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੧੦॥
You are the Giver of peace to all beings; by perfect grace one meditates on You. ॥10॥
ਜਤੁ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ; ਜਿ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
Continence, truthfulness and self-discipline are his who practises Truth;
ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ; ਜਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
that mind is pure which sings the Lord's praises.
ਇਸੁ ਬਿਖੁ ਮਹਿ. ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ; ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੧੧॥
Amid this poison the nectar is obtained — this is pleasing to my dear Lord. ॥11॥
One whom He gives understanding understands;
singing the Lord's praises, the heart is enlightened.
ਹਉਮੈ ਮੇਰਾ. ਠਾਕਿ ਰਹਾਏ; ਸਹਜੇ ਹੀ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੨॥
He holds back ego and "mine," and in poise obtains the True One. ॥12॥
Without grace, the rest of the multitude wander;
ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮੈ; ਚੁਕੈ ਨ ਫੇਰੀ ॥
dying again and again, they are born; the round does not end.
ਬਿਖੁ ਕਾ ਰਾਤਾ ਬਿਖੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ; ਸੁਖੁ. ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੩॥
Imbued with poison, one deals in poison and never finds peace. ॥13॥
Those in religious garbs wear many garbs,
ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ; ਹਉਮੈ ਕਿਨੈ. ਨ ਮਾਰੀ ॥
but without the Word no one has killed ego.
ਜੀਵਤੁ ਮਰੈ ਤਾ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਾਏ; ਸਚੈ ਨਾਇ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੧੪॥
One who dies while alive obtains liberation and merges in the True Name. ॥14॥
Ignorance and craving burn this body;
1068: ਤਿਸ ਦੀ ਬੂਝੈ; ਜਿ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਏ ॥
the fire is quenched in one who lives the Guru's Word.
ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ; ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੧੫॥
Body and mind are cooled; anger is removed; killing ego, he merges. ॥15॥
True is the Master, true His glory;
by the Guru's grace some rare one obtains it.
ਨਾਨਕੁ ਏਕ ਕਹੈ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ; ਨਾਮੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੧੬॥੧॥੨੩॥
Nanak makes one prayer: (such a one) merges in the Name alone. ॥16॥1॥23॥
By Your glance You unite Your devotees;
the devotees praise You, ever lovingly attuned.
ਤਉ ਸਰਣਾਈ. ਉਬਰਹਿ ਕਰਤੇ; ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
In Your refuge they are saved, O Creator; You Yourself unite them in union. ॥1॥
Through the perfect Word devotion is beautified;
there is peace within, and it is pleasing to Your mind.
ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸਚੀ ਭਗਤੀ ਰਾਤਾ; ਸਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
Mind and body are imbued with true devotion; the mind is fixed on the True One. ॥2॥
In ego the body ever burns;
when grace comes, one meets the Perfect Guru.
ਅੰਤਰਿ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
He dispels ignorance within through the Word; from the True Guru he finds peace. ॥3॥
The self-willed is blind and acts blindly;
he suffers many afflictions and wanders through births.
ਜਮ ਕਾ ਜੇਵੜਾ ਕਦੇ. ਨ ਕਾਟੈ; ਅੰਤੇ ਬਹੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
He never cuts Death's rope; in the end he suffers great pain. ॥4॥
One ends coming and going through the Word,
keeping the True Name enshrined in the heart.
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ. ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰੇ; ਹਉਮੈ ਜਾਇ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੫॥
One who dies through the Guru's Word subdues the mind; his ego departs and he merges. ॥5॥
Through coming and going the world is ruined;
ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ; ਥਿਰੁ ਕੋਇ. ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
without the True Guru no one becomes steady.
ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਵਸਿਆ; ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥੬॥
The Light within, peace comes to dwell through the Word; one's light merges in the Light. ॥6॥
The five demons think of vice;
this is the expanse of attachment to Maya.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ. ਤਾ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਹੋਵੈ; ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤ ਵਸਿ ਆਇਆ ॥੭॥
Serving the True Guru one is liberated; the five demons come under control. ॥7॥
Without the Guru there is the pitch darkness of attachment;
one drowns again and again, time after time.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਸਚੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ; ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੮॥
Meeting the True Guru, Truth is implanted; the True Name becomes pleasing to the mind. ॥8॥
True is His door, true His court;
those who love the Word serve the True One.
ਸਚੀ ਧੁਨਿ ਸਚੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ; ਸਚੇ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੯॥
With true melody I sing the praises of the True One and merge in the True One. ॥9॥
Within the house (of the self), some rare one finds His home,
through the Guru's Word, in poise and love.
ਓਥੈ ਸੋਗੁ ਵਿਜੋਗੁ. ਨ ਵਿਆਪੈ; ਸਹਜੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੧੦॥
There sorrow and separation do not touch him; he merges in poise upon poise. ॥10॥
In the love of duality the wicked dwell;
they wander about, full of attachment and thirst.
ਕੁਸੰਗਤਿ ਬਹਹਿ. ਸਦਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ; ਦੁਖੋ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥੧੧॥
They sit in evil company and ever suffer pain; they earn pain upon pain. ॥11॥
Without the True Guru there is no (true) company;
ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੇ; ਪਾਰੁ. ਨ ਪਾਏ ਕੋਈ ॥
without the Word no one reaches the far shore.
ਸਹਜੇ ਗੁਣ ਰਵਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ; ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥੧੨॥
Those who repeat His praises in poise day and night — their light merges in the Light. ॥12॥
The body is a tree; the bird (soul) dwells within it;
those who peck at the nectar dwell in the Guru's Word;
ਉਡਹਿ ਨ ਮੂਲੇ. ਨ ਆਵਹਿ, ਨ ਜਾਹੀ; ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੩॥
they do not fly away at all, nor come nor go; they dwell in their own home. ॥13॥
Those who purify the body and reflect on the Word
dispel the drugged sweet of attachment and doubt.
ਆਪੇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ; ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥੧੪॥
The Giver of peace Himself shows mercy; He Himself unites in union. ॥14॥
1069: ਸਦ ਹੀ ਨੇੜੈ; ਦੂਰਿ. ਨ ਜਾਣਹੁ ॥
He is ever near; do not think Him far away;
through the Guru's Word recognise Him close at hand.
ਬਿਗਸੈ ਕਮਲੁ ਕਿਰਣਿ ਪਰਗਾਸੈ; ਪਰਗਟੁ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖਾਇਆ ॥੧੫॥
The lotus blossoms, the ray (of His Light) shines; He has made Himself manifest and shown. ॥15॥
That True One Himself is the Creator;
ਆਪੇ ਮਾਰਿ ਜੀਵਾਲੇ; ਅਵਰੁ. ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
He Himself kills and revives; there is no other.
ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ; ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ. ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੬॥੨॥੨੪॥
Nanak, through the Name comes glory; losing self, one finds peace. ॥16॥2॥24॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
The True One Himself is the Adorner;
no other task occurs to (the devotee).
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੁ ਵਸੈ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ; ਸਹਜੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
In the Guru-facing the True One dwells within the heart; he merges in poise in the True One. ॥1॥
The True One dwells in the minds of all;
by the Guru's grace they merge in poise.
ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਤ. ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
Repeating "Guru, Guru," one finds lasting peace, with the mind fixed on the Guru's feet. ॥2॥
ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਹੈ ਗਿਆਨੁ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਹੈ ਪੂਜਾ ॥
The True Guru is wisdom; the True Guru is worship;
I serve the True Guru and no other.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ. ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਭਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
From the True Guru I obtained the jewel-wealth of the Name; service of the True Guru is pleasing to me. ॥3॥
Those who, without the True Guru, are attached to duality
come and go; the unfortunate die in doubt.
ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ; ਜਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਹਹਿ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
Nanak, they are saved when, through the Guru, they remain in His refuge. ॥4॥
The Guru-facing's love is ever true;
from the True Guru I beg for the priceless Name.
ਹੋਹੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ; ਰਖਿ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
Be merciful and show grace, dear Lord; keep me in the Guru's refuge. ॥5॥
The True Guru has distilled the essence of nectar;
He has become manifest in the Tenth Gate.
ਤਹ ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦ ਵਜਹਿ ਧੁਨਿ ਬਾਣੀ; ਸਹਜੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
There the unstruck melody of the Word resounds as bani; one merges in poise upon poise. ॥6॥
ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਕਰਤੈ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
Those for whom the Creator wrote it from the start
spend night and day repeating "Guru, Guru."
ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ. ਕੋ ਸੀਝੈ ਨਾਹੀ; ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
Without the True Guru no one succeeds; fix your mind on the Guru's feet. ॥7॥
Whom He pleases, He Himself gives;
the Guru-facing receives the treasure of the Name.
ਆਪੇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਵੈ; ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
He Himself shows mercy and gives the Name; Nanak, one merges in the Name. ॥8॥
The jewel of wisdom has become manifest in the mind;
in poise one has received the treasure of the Name.
ਏਹ ਵਡਿਆਈ. ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਈ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਸਦ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
This glory is obtained from the Guru; I am ever a sacrifice to the True Guru. ॥9॥
The sun has risen, and the darkness of night is dispelled;
ignorance is dispelled by the Guru's infinite jewel.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਅਤਿ ਭਾਰੀ; ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
The True Guru's jewel of wisdom is utterly precious; one who receives it by grace finds peace. ॥10॥
Through the Guru one obtains the Name, and his renown spreads;
in all four ages he is pure and good in the world.
ਨਾਮੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਨਾਮਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
Imbued with the Name alone, he finds peace and remains lovingly attuned to the Name. ॥11॥
One who obtains the Name through the Guru
wakes in poise and sleeps in poise.
1070: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ਸਮਾਵੈ; ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
Through the Guru he merges and merges in the Name; Nanak, he meditates on the Name. ॥12॥
In the mouths of the devotees is the nectar-bani;
the Guru-facing chant and expound the Lord's Name.
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਤ. ਸਦਾ ਮਨੁ ਬਿਗਸੈ; ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
Repeating "Har, Har," the mind ever blossoms, fixed on the Lord's feet. ॥13॥
ਹਮ ਮੂਰਖ ਅਗਿਆਨ; ਗਿਆਨੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
We are foolish and ignorant, with no wisdom at all;
ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ; ਸਮਝ ਪੜੀ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
from the True Guru understanding has come into the mind.
ਹੋਹੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
Be merciful and show grace, dear Lord; attach me to the True Guru's service. ॥14॥
ਜਿਨਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜਾਤਾ; ਤਿਨਿ ਏਕੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥
One who has known the True Guru has recognised the One,
the Giver of peace, pervading all.
ਆਤਮੁ ਚੀਨਿ. ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਸੇਵਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
Understanding his soul, he attains the supreme state; his awareness merges in service. ॥15॥
Those blessed with glory from the beginning
have the True Guru dwelling in their minds, lovingly attuned.
ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਦਾਤਾ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੧॥
The Giver, Life of the world, Himself meets them; Nanak, they merge in His embrace. ॥16॥1॥
The Lord is inaccessible, imperceptible, ever imperishable;
He pervades all, dwelling in every heart.
ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ. ਨ ਕੋਈ ਦਾਤਾ; ਹਰਿ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਸਰੇਵਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
Without Him there is no other Giver; serve that Lord alone, O mortal. ॥1॥
One whom the Lord, the Protector, protects —
ਤਾ ਕਉ ਕੋਇ, ਨ ਸਾਕਸਿ ਮਾਰਾ ॥
ਸੋ ਐਸਾ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਸੰਤਹੁ; ਜਾ ਕੀ ਊਤਮ ਬਾਣੀ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
So serve such a Lord, O saints, whose bani is sublime. ॥2॥
When it seems that nothing is anywhere (permanent),
then the Creator is seen pervading everywhere.
ਸੂਕੇ ਤੇ ਫੁਨਿ ਹਰਿਆ ਕੀਤੋਨੁ; ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਚੋਜ ਵਿਡਾਣੀ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
He turns the dried-up green again; meditate on the Lord of wondrous plays. ॥3॥
He who knows the pain of all beings —
I am a sacrifice to that Master.
ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਜਨ ਕਰਿ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ; ਜੋ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਕਾ ਦਾਣੀ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
O servant, offer your prayer before Him who is the Giver of all peace. ॥4॥
ਜੋ ਜੀਐ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ; ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
One who does not know the condition of another's soul —
ਤਿਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਕਿਛੁ. ਨ ਕਹੀਐ ਅਜਾਣੈ ॥
do not say anything to that ignorant one.
ਮੂਰਖ ਸਿਉ, ਨਹ ਲੂਝੁ ਪਰਾਣੀ; ਹਰਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਪਦੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੀ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
Do not wrangle with a fool, O mortal; meditate on the Lord, the state of nirvana. ॥5॥
ਨਾ ਕਰਿ ਚਿੰਤ; ਚਿੰਤਾ ਹੈ ਕਰਤੇ ॥
Do not be anxious; the worry is the Creator's;
ਹਰਿ ਦੇਵੈ; ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਜੰਤਾ ਸਭਤੈ ॥
the Lord gives to all creatures in water and on land.
ਅਚਿੰਤ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ; ਵਿਚਿ ਪਾਥਰ ਕੀਟ ਪਖਾਣੀ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
My God gives gifts unasked, even to worms within stones. ॥6॥
ਨਾ ਕਰਿ ਆਸ; ਮੀਤ ਸੁਤ ਭਾਈ ॥
Do not place hope in friends, sons or brothers;
ਨਾ ਕਰਿ ਆਸ; ਕਿਸੈ ਸਾਹ ਬਿਉਹਾਰ ਕੀ ਪਰਾਈ ॥
do not place hope in any banker or business of others.
ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਵੈ. ਕੋ ਬੇਲੀ ਨਾਹੀ; ਹਰਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਸਾਰੰਗਪਾਣੀ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
Without the Lord's Name no one is your companion; meditate on the Lord, the Sustainer of the earth. ॥7॥
Night and day chant the Name of the Lord of the forest (world);
He fulfils all your hopes and desires.
ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਭਵ ਖੰਡਨੁ; ਸੁਖਿ ਸਹਜੇ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਣੀ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
O servant Nanak, chant the Name, the Destroyer of fear; the night (of life) passes in peace and poise. ॥8॥
ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ; ਤਿਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
One who has served the Lord has found peace,
and merged in poise in the Lord's Name.
ਜੋ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੈ. ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਪਤਿ ਰਾਖੈ; ਜਾਇ ਪੂਛਹੁ ਵੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਣੀ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
He protects the honour of one who seeks His refuge — go and ask the Vedas and Puranas. ॥9॥
ਜਿਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਏ; ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
That person alone is attached whom the Lord attaches to His service;
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ; ਭਰਮ ਭਉ ਭਾਗੈ ॥
through the Guru's Word doubt and fear flee.
ਵਿਚੇ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ. ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਉਦਾਸੀ; ਜਿਉ ਕਮਲੁ ਰਹੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਪਾਣੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
Amid the household he remains ever detached, as the lotus remains in the water. ॥10॥
